implementation: Fit two pivots to the widest rings of the existing partial globe meshes. Preserve original positions, normals, UVs and material appearance.
Each avatar owns the cloned eye geometry and a two-bone eye skeleton. Original cached source geometry and bind skeletons remain unchanged.
Solve targets in the current head frame with separate eye origins, horizontal and vertical bounds, and faster damped acquisition than the head.
Layer onto the final head pose, retain purposeful tracking with reduced motion, and release behind-head or sub-0.25 m targets.
Held indoor workers track the visitor even after the conversation closes, while their task clock remains paused.

limitations: Jevica normal conversation gaze is not wired; her existing spell target drives her eyes.
Lip synchronization, expressive scanning/saccades and broader facial performance remain open.
Generic assets, character materials, cloth realism and sustained frame pacing do not yet meet a verified hyperrealistic end state.
followupEvidence: SkeletonUtils.clone creates a separate 53-bone skeleton per skinned mesh in Jevica. Several cloned meshes refer to the same cloned bones; deduplication is a candidate for a separately measured optimization. No change to this ownership was made here.
